question: Related Questions Q. Mu` meneen Brother, As Salaam Aleikum wa Rahmatullahi wa Barakatuh. Allah has blessed one more son to my friend on Eid Ul Fitr day in Dubai. Before finalizing this name, they would like to know your opinion. Can you please give your thought on this name and if you feel to suggest different names, then please go ahead and give the names which are much better than this. Your quick reply will be highly appreciated. Jazak Allah Khair! 1732 views Q. assalamu-alaikum By the grace of Allah I am blessed with a son on 12th Novemeber-2009 at 5.37PM. answer: Miscellaneous >> Islamic Names Question ID: 44146 Country: India Title: Aqsa name for girl child Question: Can we name a new born girl child as AQSA? What is the meaning of the word AQSA? Answer ID: 44146 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 416/395/N=1434) Aqsa is an Arabic word which means: farther. It is a masculine form; therefore you should not keep this name for your daughter, rather keep any other meaningful name. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
